indications.description: Previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer after standard therapies.

treatment.schedule_summary: Fruquintinib 5 mg orally once daily on days 1–21, followed by 7 days without fruquintinib; repeat every 28 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Take with or without food; swallow capsules whole.

eligibility: Adult metastatic colorectal cancer after available standard fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, irinotecan, anti-VEGF and anti-EGFR treatment as appropriate, and progression/intolerance on either trifluridine-tipiracil or regorafenib.
ECOG 0–2; adequate haematological, renal and liver function.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity; uncontrolled hypertension; severe hepatic impairment; thromboembolism in the preceding 6 months; stroke/TIA in the preceding 12 months; pregnancy/breastfeeding.
monitoring: Baseline and regularly: FBC, renal and liver profile, urine protein, BP and thyroid function. INR if clinically indicated.
BP weekly during the first month, then monthly and as clinically indicated. For warfarin, monitor INR weekly until stable, then before each cycle.
Disease monitoring follows the consultant’s treatment plan; no fixed scan interval is stated.
Monitor bleeding, proteinuria, hand-foot symptoms, GI perforation symptoms and wound healing. Review concomitant medicines, especially strong/moderate CYP3A inducers.
dose_modifications: Consultant-led dose levels: 5 mg daily, then 4 mg, then 3 mg; discontinue if 3 mg cannot be tolerated.
Grade 2 hand-foot toxicity resumes at the same dose after recovery; grade 3 requires a reduction.
Proteinuria hold threshold is ≥2 g per 24 hours; restart requires full resolution or <1 g per 24 hours. Bleeding requires full resolution or grade 1.
Use clinician-confirmed CTCAE v5 grades and baseline comparisons for the other toxicity-specific holds, reduced restarts and stop rules.
Other grade 4 toxicity is discontinued; a reduced-dose restart is only a consultant risk-benefit decision after recovery.
